title: Legacy Workplace settings: offices, occupancy and attendance goals, department mapping and workplace tags

prose.text: Whether the legacy Offices list has a BSSIDs column is open {{gap:bssid-column}}. Insights that use these settings are in [[business-insights.legacy.workplace]], the current office fields are in [[business-insights.offices]], and the area hub is [[business-insights.legacy]].

office-read-only.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, An admin account with read-only access can only view offices and use the View icon to see office configuration details.

quotes: An admin account with read-only access to the Business Insights Admin Portal can only view the offices and use the View icon to view office configuration details.

office-list-fields.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Offices list includes Building ID, Site ID, Size in square feet, Lease Status (leased or owned), Lease End Date, Permanent Desks, Hotel Desks, Capacity and Assigned Headcount.

quotes: Lease Status: Indicates whether the office building is leased or owned.
Permanent Desks: The number of permanent desks in the office.
Hotel Desks: The number of hotel desks available in the office.
Size: The size of the office in square feet.
Building ID: The unique building ID assigned to the office building.
Site ID: The ID assigned to the office.
Lease End Date: The date when the office building lease ends.
Capacity: The number of employees the office can accommodate.
Assigned Headcount: The number of users assigned to the office.

office-goal-columns.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Offices list shows an Occupancy Goal (60 means at least 60% of assigned users) and an Attendance Goal of 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100 for 1 to 5 days per week.

quotes: Occupancy Goal: The occupancy goal in percentage for the office. For example, if the occupancy goal is set to 60, the office is expected to be occupied by at least 60% of its assigned users.
Attendance Goal: The attendance goal in percentage for the office (i.e., 20, 40, 60, 80, or 100 for 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 days per week, respectively).

office-error-icon.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On the Offices list, hovering over the Error icon next to an office name gives reasons such as incorrect configuration, missing metadata, or an office configured less than 24 hours ago.

quotes: (e.g., the office is not configured correctly, metadata is not added, the office was configured less than 24 hours ago, etc.)
If you don't see data for the office, hover over the Error icon
next to the office name to see the reason

office-capacity-headcount.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Capacity helps calculate an office's occupancy and Assigned Headcount helps calculate its attendance metrics.

quotes: Capacity: Enter the number of employees the office can accommodate. This value helps calculate the occupancy of the office.
Assigned Headcount: Enter the number of users that you want to assign to the office. This value helps calculate the attendance metrics for the office.

office-new-locations.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A location newly added in the ZIA Admin Portal appears in the Add Office locations field after one day, and several IP addresses can be entered separated by commas.

quotes: Any new location added to the ZIA Admin Portal is reflected in this field after one day.
You can enter multiple IP addresses using commas to separate each IP address.

office-tag-limit.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, At most 8 tags can be manually linked to an office.

quotes: You can only manually link a maximum of 8 tags.

office-delete-effect.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Once an office is configured the service aggregates data for its locations and IP addresses, and deleting it stops that aggregation and shows metrics for each ZIA location, sublocation and IP address individually.

quotes: If you delete the office, the Business Insights service stops data aggregation for the office and initiates the display of metrics for each ZIA location, sublocation, and IP address individually in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
The Business Insights service starts aggregating data for the associated ZIA locations, sublocations, and IP addresses under this office.

goal-values.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The organization-level occupancy goal is entered as a value between 1 and 100, and the organization-level attendance goal as 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100 for 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 days per week.

quotes: enter the occupancy goal between 1 and 100
enter the attendance goal (i.e., 20, 40, 60, 80, or 100 for 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 days per week, respectively).

goal-office-values.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The office-level occupancy goal is entered between 1 and 100 and the office-level attendance goal as 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100 for 1 to 5 days per week.

quotes: Occupancy Goal Percentage: Enter the occupancy goal between 1 and 100.
Attendance Goal Percentage: Enter the attendance goal (i.e., 20, 40, 60, 80, or 100 for 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 days per week, respectively).

department-mapping-limit.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Up to 32 divisions can be created in Department Mapping.

quotes: You can add up to 32 divisions.

department-mapping-columns.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Department Mapping list shows each Division, its Departments, the Number of Departments and the Employees mapped to the division.

quotes: Number of Departments: The number of departments mapped to the division.
Employees: The number of employees mapped to the division.
Division: The name of the division.
Departments: The departments that are mapped to the division.

workplace-tag-limits.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Workplace tags allow at most 8 tag categories with 8 tags each.

quotes: You can add a maximum of 8 tag categories, and each category can consist of 8 tags.

workplace-tag-single.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, When manually tagging offices, only one tag in a category can be linked to an office.

quotes: Note that only one tag in a category can be linked to an office.

workplace-tag-criteria.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Dynamic workplace tag criteria are Assigned Headcounts, Capacity, Hotel Desks, Lease End Date, Lease Status and Permanent Desks, with operators greater than, greater than or equal to, less than, less than or equal to, equal to, Contains and Not Contains.

quotes: - Assigned Headcounts
- Capacity
- Hotel Desks
- Lease End Date
- Lease Status
- Permanent Desks

Operator: Select an operator to set the threshold to satisfy the criteria as greater than (>), greater than or equal to (>=), less than (<), less than or equal to (<=), equal to (=), Contains, or Not Contains.

goal-denominator.summary: The Offices list describes an occupancy goal against an office's assigned users, while the office configuration and terminology articles calculate occupancy from Capacity.

quotes: if the occupancy goal is set to 60, the office is expected to be occupied by at least 60% of its assigned users.

positions.says: An occupancy goal is described as the share of an office's assigned users expected to occupy it.

quotes: Capacity: Enter the number of employees the office can accommodate. This value helps calculate the occupancy of the office.

positions.says: Capacity, not Assigned Headcount, is the office value that helps calculate occupancy.

goal-denominator.impact: Whether an occupancy goal is compared against assigned users or against Capacity is not stated; the Offices list and the occupancy formulas name different denominators.

bssid-column.title: Whether the legacy Offices list has a BSSIDs column
bssid-column.detail: The current Offices list in business-insights.offices includes BSSIDs; the legacy Offices list has Tags and Location columns, and no BSSIDs column was found in the legacy captures. That absence comes from diffing the two captures, not from a statement in either.
